<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# First, reset the grid by clicking a purple dot
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 55, 'col': 15}])
print("After clicking purple dot:")
print("Board changed:", result['board_changed'])

# Check right grid
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("\nRight grid blocks after reset:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 9:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        if min(rows) >= 47:
            r, c = (min(rows)+max(rows))//2, (min(cols)+max(cols))//2
            print(f"  color={n['color']}, center=({r},{c})")

# Now try UP to change bar configuration
result = action(['UP'])
print("\nAfter UP:")
print("Board changed:", result['board_changed'])

# Check bar state
print("\nBar parts after UP:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['g', 'S', 'b'] and n['pixels'] > 5 and n['pixels'] < 100:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        if min(rows) < 30:
            print(f"  color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, rows=({min(rows)},{max(rows)}), cols=({min(cols)},{max(cols)})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
